name: display-dev
description: Publish, inspect, edit, and share HTML or Markdown artifacts with access controls.

interface.longDescription: Publish HTML and Markdown from your agent as display.dev artifacts. Browse and search published work, read bounded source context, make exact versioned edits, copy artifacts, share them with public, private, or company-authenticated access, and iterate on reviewer comments. For teams whose agents write reports, specs, and other documents that people review. The plugin bundles the display.dev skill and the remote display.dev MCP server. You sign in to display.dev through OAuth, and the plugin acts only on the artifacts and settings your account can access. Billing changes stay in the display.dev dashboard.
